input.summary: Replace Singapore governing law and exclusive Singapore forum in § 28.1 with New York law, leaving § 28.2's exclusive New York County forum intact.
input.comment: [Playbook] We replaced Singapore law and the exclusive Singapore forum with New York law, which is our accepted position and removes the conflict with § 28.2's exclusive New York County jurisdiction (Delaware, California or England and Wales with London courts would be an acceptable fallback).

ops.oldText: This Agreement is governed exclusively by Singapore law, and the courts of Singapore have exclusive jurisdiction.
ops.newText: This Agreement is governed exclusively by New York law.
